relationships.subject: astrocyte-neuronal lactate shuttling
relationships.evidence_quote: ANLS in the mouse ACC promotes the development of chronic inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: astrocyte-neuronal lactate shuttling
relationships.evidence_quote: disrupting astrocyte-neuronal lactate shuttling in the ACC prior to inflammatory injury prevents the development of pain hypersensitivity in female and male mice

key_findings: ANLS in ACC promotes chronic inflammatory pain with sex-specific activation; only males show sustained lactate increases.
Disrupting ANLS in ACC before injury prevents hypersensitivity in both sexes.
